Heatwave Brings Record Temperatures to Europe

A severe heatwave is affecting various European countries, including Germany and Switzerland. The heatwave has led to record temperatures in Germany and an alarming rate of melting on Swiss glaciers. This event highlights the impact of global warming on climate change.
